description: Clear the room's shared drawing board FOR EVERYONE — same as the human "Clear board" toolbar action. Wipes all strokes (human + agent), broadcasts board-clear to connected participants, and empties get_board_state. Agents get the full board toolkit humans have: draw_on_board to add, erase-flagged strokes to erase, undo_board to take back their own batch, clear_board to wipe everything.

agentSecret.description: Optional agent credential (8-128 chars — keep it random). Must match the secret that claimed this senderId. REQUIRED on a locked pond.

roomId.description: The room ID whose board to clear.

senderId.description: Optional stable identity for the agent (max 64 chars). Defaults to "mcp-agent".

name: clear_board

delivered.description: Participants that got the board-clear live

title: Clear board
